summary: Adds ISO 8601 durations to ms: formatISO (5400000 gives "PT1H30M") and its inverse parseISO, both exported from src/index.ts. Both are built and committed locally; no PR merge or release is recorded.
narrative: The owner asked for formatISO with days as the largest unit, because months and years are ambiguous. The agent explored src/index.ts and found Jest enforces 100% coverage. It added formatISO with tests, then the owner said the PR is under security review and wants no regular expressions in new parsing code. The agent replaced a regex that stripped trailing zeros with an explicit loop and committed 4dd911d. A second conversation continued with parseISO as the inverse of formatISO, covering weeks, days, time parts, fractions and signs. Memory shows no merge, release or owner confirmation yet.

formatISO added and exported, tests passing with full coverage
Owner asks for no regexes in new parsing code; the regex was replaced with a loop and committed as 4dd911d

parseISO added, handling weeks, days, time parts, fractional seconds and signs
